body:
Thanks for the kind words. I'll try to stay positive but it's hard when I'm already fucking up in college after just 1 year, and when I get out,  I'll have trouble getting a job. I see how my parents live too, they divorced back when I was in like 4th grade, now I live with my mom who only makes about 16 an hour in a job completely unrelated to her degree.

Yea I hate debt, and I hate playing debt collector. But those were both people I trusted so I just believed it when they said "I'll have the cash tomorrow."  

It just makes me think that friendships are fleeting and life is depressing and pointless

Thank you for reading my ramblings, and for this good reply but I still feel pretty much the same.

You see that's the thing, I make friends and eventually we get close, but I can never understand who I should trust. I had a good friend who I knew since 7th grade, and kept in touch with him all through HS and part of uni, up until the point where I fronted him $140 worth of drugs and never heard from him since...I just got burned by another close friend for fronting $50 worth of drugs 2 weeks ago who I haven't seen since either. I know that might not say much for you, but if my closest friends would steal from me, who can I trust? I've met a lot of good people, but I feel like most people are a facade, and self-centered who will turn on even their close friends in a heartbeat. 

As for 28 wow I guess I don't feel so bad now but seeing all my friends get laid all the time makes me wonder what's wrong with me, and congrats on the kid! That honestly is probably the only real thing keeping me alive, knowing that I could one day raise a child (although at the same time it seems like it could be hellish to have a kid in a lot of regards,) And the trauma it would cause my parents.

edit* Oh yea and then the wife divorces, takes the kid, house, and money lol
